LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B / B2C - Single KPI tile with inline trend chart. 4 chart styles (line, area, bar, mini-donut), optional comparison series, target line, currency formatting. Bilingual FR / EN.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default ('Indicateur' / 'Metric').

property.name: hideCardTitle
property.label: Hide the card wrapper
property.description: Off by default - the tile is wrapped in a lightning-card with a title. Turn on to render the bare tile (no card header) for dense dashboards.

property.name: metricLabel
property.label: Metric label (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the language default ('CA (12 mois)' / 'Revenue (12 mo.)').

property.name: currentValueDisplay
property.label: Headline value (text override)
property.description: Large value shown at the top of the tile. Wins over the numeric currentValue when set. Leave empty for the language default.

property.name: currentValue
property.label: Headline value (numeric, optional)
property.description: Numeric value used to auto-format the headline via Intl.NumberFormat (compact currency). Ignored when 'Headline value (text override)' is set.

property.name: currencyCode
property.label: Currency ISO code
property.description: Used by the numeric formatter. ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD, GBP...).

property.name: chartStyle
property.label: Chart style
property.description: 'line' (curve only), 'area' (curve + filled area below), 'bar' (vertical bars), 'mini-donut' (radial gauge from currentValue / targetValue).

property.name: seriesJson
property.label: Series points - JSON array
property.description: Array of numbers. 12 points = one per month. Leave empty for a sample up-trend curve. Ignored by 'mini-donut' style.

property.name: secondarySeriesJson
property.label: Secondary series - JSON array (optional)
property.description: Optional comparison series (e.g. forecast, target run-rate). Drawn as a dashed line. Ignored by 'mini-donut' style.

property.name: targetValue
property.label: Target value (optional)
property.description: When set, draws a horizontal dashed line at this Y on line/area/bar charts. Used as the denominator for the mini-donut variant.

property.name: showTargetLabel
property.label: Show target label chip
property.description: Off by default. Turn ON to display a 'Target XX €' chip next to the metric label.

property.name: scalingMode
property.label: Y-axis scaling
property.description: 'auto' (data min/max), 'from-zero' (forces Y origin to 0), 'fixed' (uses yMin / yMax below).

property.name: accentColor
property.label: Accent color (hex)
property.description: Color of the primary chart series. Defaults to CCO FR brand blue.

property.name: donutTrack
property.label: Mini-donut track color (hex)
property.description: Background ring color. Used only when chartStyle = mini-donut.

property.name: height
property.label: Chart height (px)
property.description: Internal viewBox height. CSS scales the SVG to fit the column width.

property.name: width
property.label: Chart width override (px)
property.description: 0 = auto (default ~600px viewBox). Set a fixed value for very narrow tiles.

property.name: trendDisplay
property.label: Trend badge text
property.description: Sign drives the color: a leading '+' (or no sign on a non-zero number) is green, '-' is red, '0%' is grey.

property.name: enableTooltip
property.label: Enable hover tooltip
property.description: Off by default. Turn ON to show value-on-point on hover (line / area / bar).

property.name: trendPositive
property.label: (deprecated) Trend is positive
property.description: No longer used - the color is auto-derived from the sign of trendDisplay.
